name: iter_staging_budget
description: Is a fixed data budget better spent in ONE round or spread over MANY? Sweeps the trajectory length against the per-round budget along the constant-product diagonal (1x800, 2x400, 4x200, 8x100, 16x50), so every cell adds the same 800 curated points in total and only the STAGING differs. Each run also computes the budget- and compute-matched single-shot control (ss_guided_mae / ss_random_mae), giving a within-run reference as well as the across-cell comparison. This is the question the single-round study defined out of existence. Accumulative regime, one detector, 10 seeds.
